caption: You probably never noticed what happens when you use a dirty sponge to wipe down your kitchen counters 🤔🧹
comments_seeded: I just throw mine in the dishwasher when it gets dirty, is that enough?
Sometimes I think about all the places I've used that sponge before, it's a bit unsettling
Do you guys make a habit of replacing your sponges regularly or just when they start to smell?
It's funny how something as small as a sponge can be linked to the cleanliness of our whole kitchen
What's the weirdest place you've ever used a sponge to clean, and did you think twice about using it again after that? 🧹
